components.name: Primary action
components.description: Open the evidence behind a change.
components.css: .ds-primary{min-height:32px;padding:0 12px;border-radius:var(--control-radius,10px);font:510 12px Geist,"Segoe UI",sans-serif;cursor:pointer;background:var(--mist,#eeeeee);color:var(--void,#101010);border:1px solid var(--selection,#eeeeee)}.ds-primary:hover{background:#d8d5d2}.ds-primary:disabled{opacity:.45;cursor:not-allowed}.ds-primary:focus-visible,.ds-secondary:focus-visible,.ds-search:focus-visible,.ds-nav button:focus-visible,.ds-chip:focus-visible,.ds-row:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--selection,#eeeeee);outline-offset:2px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference){.ds-primary,.ds-secondary,.ds-nav button{transition:background-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1),border-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1)}}

components.name: Secondary action
components.description: A supporting action beside the primary evidence action.

components.css: .ds-observations{padding:0 24px;border:1px solid var(--graphite,#3d3a39);border-radius:var(--surface-radius,16px);background:var(--carbon,#151413);font:14px/1.6 Geist,"Segoe UI",sans-serif;color:var(--fog,#b8b3b0)}.ds-observation{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) auto;gap:24px;align-items:center;padding:22px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--divider,rgba(238,238,238,.12))}.ds-observation:last-child{border-bottom:0}.ds-observation h3{margin:0 0 6px;font-size:16px;font-weight:500;color:var(--mist,#eeeeee)}.ds-observation header{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px 16px;align-items:center;margin-bottom:8px;font-size:12px}.ds-observation small{padding:3px 8px;border-radius:6px;background:var(--surface-interactive,#24211f);font-size:12px}.ds-observation p{max-width:72ch;margin:0}.ds-observation footer{display:flex;gap:8px;justify-content:flex-end;flex-wrap:wrap}.ds-observation button{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;min-height:34px;padding:6px 10px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:var(--control-radius,10px);background:transparent;color:var(--fog,#b8b3b0);font:12px Geist,"Segoe UI",sans-serif;cursor:pointer}.ds-observation .ds-evidence{color:var(--paper,#fff);border-color:var(--divider,rgba(238,238,238,.12))}.ds-observation button:hover{background:var(--surface-interactive,#24211f)}@media(max-width:900px){.ds-observations{padding:0 18px}.ds-observation{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);gap:14px;padding:20px 0}.ds-observation footer{justify-content:flex-start}}.ds-observation button:focus-visible,.ds-feed-row:focus-visible,.ds-caption button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--selection,#eeeeee);outline-offset:2px}

components.name: Inset Live feed
components.description: Opaque enclosed feed with quiet separators and readable selected connection rows.
components.html: Live connections 2
components.css: .ds-feed{overflow:hidden;border:1px solid var(--graphite,#3d3a39);border-radius:var(--surface-radius,16px);background:var(--obsidian,#1d1a18);font:14px Geist,"Segoe UI",sans-serif;color:var(--fog,#b8b3b0)}.ds-feed>header{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;height:60px;padding:0 18px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--divider,rgba(238,238,238,.12))}.ds-feed strong{color:var(--mist,#eeeeee)}.ds-feed-list{padding:8px}.ds-feed-row{display:grid;gap:6px;min-height:112px;width:100%;padding:12px 10px;border:0;border-radius:10px;background:transparent;text-align:left;color:var(--mist,#eeeeee);font:14px Geist,"Segoe UI",sans-serif;cursor:pointer}.ds-feed-row+button{margin-top:8px}.ds-feed-row:hover{background:#292522}.ds-feed-row[aria-pressed=true]{background:#34302c}.ds-feed-row strong{font-size:16px}.ds-feed-row code{font:14px "Geist Mono",ui-monospace,monospace}.ds-feed-row span{font-size:12px;color:var(--fog,#b8b3b0)}.ds-observation button:focus-visible,.ds-feed-row:focus-visible,.ds-caption button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--selection,#eeeeee);outline-offset:2px} .ds-protocol{padding:2px 6px;border-radius:6px;background:var(--selection-muted,rgba(238,238,238,.08));color:var(--mist,#eeeeee);font:normal 12px "Geist Mono",ui-monospace,monospace}.ds-status{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;color:var(--fog,#b8b3b0);font-size:12px}.ds-status i{width:5px;height:5px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--fog,#b8b3b0)}.ds-active i{background:var(--state-positive,#a0ca92)}

components.name: Floating geographic controls and legend
components.description: Bordered warm glass controls, opaque contrast fallback and marker-matched legend.
components.html: This deviceActive destinationSelected route
components.css: .ds-map-controls{display:inline-flex;gap:2px;margin:4px;padding:4px;border:1px solid var(--glass-edge,rgba(238,238,238,.3));border-radius:14px;background:var(--glass-surface,rgba(29,26,24,.9));backdrop-filter:blur(20px) saturate(110%);box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.14),0 8px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.22)}.ds-map-controls button{min-height:36px;padding:0 14px;border:0;border-radius:10px;background:transparent;color:var(--mist,#eeeeee);font:12px Geist,"Segoe UI",sans-serif;cursor:pointer}.ds-map-controls button[aria-pressed=true]{background:var(--smoke,#4d4947)}.ds-map-zoom button{min-height:32px;border-radius:4px;background:#191b1d}.ds-map-zoom button:hover{background:#282b2e;color:var(--paper,#fff)}.ds-map-controls button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--selection,#eeeeee);outline-offset:2px}.ds-legend{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:16px;margin:12px 4px;color:var(--fog,#b8b3b0);font:12px Geist,"Segoe UI",sans-serif}.ds-legend span{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px}.ds-legend i{width:5px;height:5px;border-radius:50%}.ds-home{background:var(--state-positive,#a0ca92);outline:1px solid var(--mist,#eeeeee);outline-offset:2px}.ds-destination{background:#a4acaf}.ds-selected{background:var(--state-warning,#ee6018)}.ds-map-controls button:hover{background:var(--surface-interactive,#24211f)}.ds-map-controls.ds-opaque{background:var(--obsidian,#1d1a18);backdrop-filter:none}@media(prefers-reduced-transparency:reduce){.ds-map-controls{background:var(--obsidian,#1d1a18);backdrop-filter:none}}@supports not(backdrop-filter:blur(1px)){.ds-map-controls{background:var(--obsidian,#1d1a18)}}

components.name: Command palette
components.description: Scrollable commands with keyboard hints, visible selection and an opaque alternative.
components.html: UP/DOWN Navigate ENTER Select
components.css: .ds-palette{width:min(650px,100%);max-height:calc(100dvh - 48px);display:flex;flex-direction:column;border:1px solid rgba(238,238,238,.45);border-radius:18px;background:var(--glass-surface,rgba(29,26,24,.9));background-image:linear-gradient(145deg,rgba(238,238,238,.08),transparent 45%);color:var(--mist,#eeeeee);font:14px Geist,"Segoe UI",sans-serif;backdrop-filter:blur(28px) saturate(110%);box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.2),0 24px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.5)}.ds-palette label{display:grid;gap:6px;padding:14px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--glass-edge,rgba(238,238,238,.3));color:var(--fog,#b8b3b0)}.ds-palette input{padding:6px;border:1px solid var(--graphite,#3d3a39);border-radius:10px;background:var(--carbon,#151413);color:var(--mist,#eeeeee);font:16px Geist,"Segoe UI",sans-serif}.ds-palette>div{max-height:min(480px,65dvh);overflow:auto;padding:10px}.ds-palette button{display:block;width:100%;min-height:44px;padding:0 14px;border:0;border-radius:10px;background:transparent;color:inherit;text-align:left;font:14px Geist,"Segoe UI",sans-serif;cursor:pointer}.ds-palette button:hover,.ds-palette .ds-active{background:rgba(238,238,238,.14)}.ds-palette .ds-active{outline:1px solid var(--glass-edge,rgba(238,238,238,.3));outline-offset:-1px}.ds-palette button:focus-visible,.ds-palette input:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--selection,#eeeeee);outline-offset:2px}.ds-palette footer{padding:14px;color:var(--fog,#b8b3b0);border-top:1px solid var(--glass-edge,rgba(238,238,238,.3))}.ds-palette kbd{font:12px "Geist Mono",monospace;color:var(--mist,#eeeeee)}.ds-palette.ds-opaque{background:var(--obsidian,#1d1a18);backdrop-filter:none}@media(prefers-reduced-transparency:reduce){.ds-palette{background:var(--obsidian,#1d1a18);backdrop-filter:none}}@supports not(backdrop-filter:blur(1px)){.ds-palette{background:var(--obsidian,#1d1a18)}}

components.name: Notification evidence panel
components.description: Opaque enclosed inbox with a quiet separator and centered empty state.
components.css: .ds-inbox{padding:18px 20px;border:1px solid var(--graphite,#3d3a39);border-radius:var(--surface-radius,16px);background:var(--carbon,#151413);color:var(--fog,#b8b3b0);font:14px/1.6 Geist,"Segoe UI",sans-serif}.ds-inbox header{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding-bottom:14px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--divider,rgba(238,238,238,.12))}.ds-inbox h2{margin:0;color:var(--mist,#eeeeee);font-size:18px;font-weight:500}.ds-inbox header span{font:12px "Geist Mono",monospace;color:var(--mist,#eeeeee)}.ds-inbox p{min-height:84px;display:grid;place-items:center;margin:14px 0 0;text-align:center}

narrative.overview:
Axvaris presents network evidence in a restrained desktop workspace. Factory and Gotham are the confirmed references for its serious observability character. The selected Axvaris guide of 2026-10-13 establishes the current composition and materials. A straight sidebar anchors warm opaque evidence panels with quiet enclosing edges. Bordered warm glass separates floating geographic and temporal controls and the command palette from the evidence behind them. The globe shares the workspace with the feed; evidence remains available when a destination cannot be plotted.

The serif AXVARIS wordmark supplies the identity. Interface text uses Geist and technical values use Geist Mono. Motion responds to an action or a data change. Continuous decorative particles and pulsing chrome have no role in this design.
keyCharacteristics: Five persistent investigation areas in a left sidebar.
Monochrome controls with limited color for evidence states.
Full-width observations with titles before category and scope, beside snapshot comparisons.
Distinct geographic, device, listener and retained-evidence workspaces.
Larger values and row names above quieter metadata.
Local brand and font assets, with no remote font dependency.

rules.name: The Evidence Color Rule
rules.body: Use color to identify a capture or evidence state. Keep general navigation and actions monochrome.

rules.name: The Identity Rule
rules.body: Use the supplied serif wordmark and its matching X. Do not add a crossing line or reconstruct the logo with a system font.

rules.name: The Panel Rule
rules.body: Keep evidence, tables and fields opaque. Use warm glass and shadows for floating controls and transient overlays, with an opaque fallback under enhanced contrast, reduced transparency or missing backdrop-filter support.

dos: Do use the supplied serif AXVARIS wordmark and matching X.
Do keep process names, evidence text and metric values stronger than metadata.
Do place observation titles before category and scope, with quiet inline actions.
Do preserve the Live reader's scroll position during background group refreshes.
Do match legend symbols to the actual home, destination and selected-route colors.
Do preserve the five-area sidebar and stacked compact Live layout.
Do keep visible focus, text labels for states and reduced motion behavior.
Do distinguish local capture, imported DNS queries and demo data in the interface.
Do keep evidence opaque and reserve warm glass for floating controls and the command palette.
Do retain snapshot identity, zeros, unavailable values and unknown attribution.
Do group local devices by interface and inspect observed relationships beside their source.
donts: Don't add a crossing line, glow or neon accent to the brand assets.
Don't use continuous decorative particles or pulsing chrome.
Don't draw destinations without known coordinates.
Don't turn imported DNS queries into confirmed connections or remote process identities.
Don't describe the UI as certified accessible or resource-efficient without corresponding validation evidence.
Don't turn neighbor cache entries into proof of observed traffic or draw invented device links.
Don't use generated map geometry as geographic evidence.
